descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S18 A change from a second session, or during Save Note processing, is not undone by Save Note

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 Re-saving the pre-round note with different content leaves every point untouched: Save Note never adds, edits, or removes a point. (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 2; TFA-92590 description) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • T3 A deleted Important Point never comes back unless the physician enters it again. (TFA-94699 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes. (UAT TC-12; UAT 3.3; TFA-92590 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Hospital patient with points A and B, editor open in session 1; Nursing Home resident with point D, editor open in session 1

When Session 2 (a runner write) deletes B and adds C on the Hospital patient while session 1's editor is open; session 1 types a note and taps Save Note; while 'Updating structured summary...' shows, session 2 adds F. Nursing Home: session 2 adds E while the editor is open; …

Then Hospital stored list is [A, C, F]; Nursing Home is [D, E, G]: Save Note neither brings B back nor drops C, E, F or G

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): backendChecks after each Save Note completes (U3, T3): Hospital texts == [A, C, F], Nursing Home == [D, E, G]. Main's Hospital usePreRoundProcess writes the list captured at tap time after the parse returns, and Nursing Home rebuilds from the editor box: expected Fail. …

Where it ran: dev; test method MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S18 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-12.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
